data.name: Macquarie Ratesaver Card
data.description: The Macquarie RateSaver Credit Card is designed for customers who want a credit card with a lower annual fee and/or interest rates than those that apply to rewards credit cards.

features.additionalInfo: Up to 55 days interest free on purchases.
A primary cardholder can apply for an additional cardholder to be added to their account.
We don't charge international purchase fees when you shop overseas or with international online retailers. Receive the Visa foreign exchange rate, with no additional fees or charges.
Macquarie Authenticator is our two-factor authentication app designed to maximise your security

constraints.additionalInfo: The credit limit we give you will depend on your ability to meet your repayments.

eligibility.additionalInfo: Earn a minimum taxable income of $50,000 per annum.

eligibility.additionalValue: Must be a permanent resident of Australia.

eligibility.additionalInfo: Approval is subject to Macquarie credit criteria and suitability assessment.
Credit cards may be made available for Macquarie home loan customers, Business Bank clients and Private Bank clients.

fees.name: Cash advance fee
fees.additionalInfo: $5.00 or 3% of the value of the transaction, whichever is the greater.

eligibility.additionalInfo: These fees are subject to your current financial table.

fees.name: International purchase fee
fees.additionalInfo: We don't charge fees for card purchases made or processed outside Australia but others, such as the banks of international merchants and foreign ATM operators, may charge fees for these transactions.

eligibility.additionalInfo: These fees are subject to your current financial table.
